request: During a partitioned rolling update of a StatefulSet (rollingUpdate.partition > 0), readiness is judged on the replicas the partition updates: once those updated replicas are ready, the StatefulSet counts as ready even while status.currentRevision still differs from status.updateRevision. Without a partition, a revision mismatch still means not ready.

defects.description: Published bug fixed upstream: Fixes Readiness Check for statefulsets using partitioned rolling update. (#11774)

trigger.input:
printf %s '' | base64 -d > pkg/kube/ready_test.go
if go test -count=1 -run '^(Test_ReadyChecker_statefulSetReady)$' ./pkg/kube >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo probe: pass; else echo probe: fail; fi

defects.why_missed: The project's own suite at the parent commit never exercised this input; the fix commit added the test that does.
